request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Turn it into a fireworks cart: replace the one big red rocket with a rack of five fireworks rockets of different sizes on thin wooden sticks, pointing up: paper tubes in grubby red, orange, yellow, one blue and one green, each with a cream paper cone tip and a fuse, one fuse lit with a small spark. The cart becomes rickety weathered brown planks with wooden wheels. The goblin wears an orange-brown leather cap. Keep the size, the goblin, black outline and art style.
